items.summary: A four-year project aims to develop technical guidance to help produce more effective, safer and efficient testing of new reactor and fuel technologies in research reactors.

items.title: Second US port to explore nuclear maritime technologies
items.summary: The Port of Corpus Christi in Texas has signed an agreement with the US Department of Transportation's Maritime Administration to explore the use of small modular reactors, microgrids, and advanced vessel propulsion systems. The port is also to collaborate with Core Power for a site-specific maritime nuclear readiness study.

items.title: Bruce Power gets go-ahead for isotope processing
items.summary: Canada's nuclear regulator has authorised Bruce Power to operate the on-site facility to carry out an important step in the production process for lutetium-177, used in the treatment of prostate cancer and in targeted therapies in precision medicine.
